verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet operations platform, so simulation, synthetic data generation and RL training are a fair question for its category. The evidence pack covers only telemetry ingestion, teleoperation, analytics, commands and fleet orchestration. Nothing documents simulation environments, synthetic training data generation, or reinforcement learning at scale.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate synthetic training data and run reinforcement learning at scale in simulation
